name: cutaway
framing: A wide cinematic cutaway seen straight on from the side, like a doll's house with its front wall removed, filling the whole frame. A standing adult would be about a fifth of the image height. Lit at night by its own lamps. No text, no captions, no border.
prompt: A cross-section of a decaying concrete apartment block at night, three floors visible. The middle floor, from about a third of the way down to just below two thirds of the image height and across most of the width, is Luna's small one-room flat, lit warm and dim by a few bare bulbs; the floors above and below are dark, other people's flats seen as dim rooms with one or two faint lamps and the dark silhouette of a neighbour. Thick concrete floor slabs and pillars, rusty pipes along the ceilings and down the outside of the building. On the left, the open side of the building: the city outside in thick yellow-green smog, factory chimneys and grey panel blocks, rain. Her flat, from left to right: a narrow shower cubicle with a dripping shower head; a hook with a towel; a kitchen corner with a two-ring hot plate, a dented kettle and a small sink under a cracked mirror; a wide window with a cracked pane onto grey smog and other blocks; a thin mattress on the floor under the window with a grey blanket; an old radiator; stacks of brown-paper parcels tied with string; a desk under a grey steampunk wall screen of gauges, valves and a small dark screen bolted to the wall; a battered fridge; a coat hook with a long grey-maroon raincoat; and at the right end of the flat a dented steel front door with extra bolts. The floor of her flat is worn linoleum, flat and clear to walk along from end to end. No people in her flat.
concierge: The city AI's version of the same building and flat, every object in the same place and the same size: her flat warm, cosy and stylish, lit amber by soft lamps; the shower a sleek glass cubicle; the kitchen corner a glossy kitchenette with a chrome kettle and a clean oval mirror; the window looking out on a glittering night city of magenta, violet and blue neon towers with signs in English, Chinese and Japanese; the mattress a low designer bed with crisp white linen; the parcels neat white boxes with a small infinity logo; the wall screen a large sleek monitor glowing soft blue; the fridge smooth and white; the coat a long glossy red coat; the door a smooth white panel framed in a thin line of light. The open side of the building shows the neon city in purple haze, flying cars and tall holograms. The flats above and below are dim and cosy, touched by neon. No people in her flat.
